LET’S DO IT YOUR WAY.
Dakota Big Horn Extended Cab in Bright Silver Metallic.
DAKOTA BIG HORN. RIGHT-SIZED FOR BIG FUN — AND BIG JOBS. When you need an all-around pickup,
go straight to the top of the list — namely, all the best-in-class[1] features that separate Dakota from other pickups.
Offering power, comfort, and capability, Dakota Big Horn — available on all Crew Cab and Extended Cab
models — is all about making life easier.
THE PERFECTLY PACKAGED PICKUP. Dakota Big Horn models feature standard automatic transmission,
17-inch cast aluminum machined wheels, P265 on-/off-road tires, body-color front and rear bumpers, silver accent
color grille, fog lamps and Big Horn badging. And the great state of Texas gets its own identity where Big Horn
models are badged as Dakota Lone Star trucks.
FLEXIBLE FUEL FOR FLEXIBLE LIFESTYLES. When it comes to V8 power, Dakota holds
a class-exclusive[1] grip. With 302 horsepower and 329 lb-ft of torque, the available 4.7-liter
Flex Fuel engine is the most powerful engine in its class.[1] That E85 compatibility allows energy flexibility, letting
you run on either unleaded gasoline (with an octane rating of 87), E85 ethanol — or any combination of the two.
And super-practical teams up with tough: that available 4.7-liter V8 supplies best-in-class[1] available horsepower
and torque and best-in-class[1] maximum available towing capacity. Riding Dakota means you’re ready for whatever
life hands you. Take on the full load of facts at dodge.com/dakota
